model.name: universalActionBar.applicableActionsFor
model.description: The SHARED universalActionBar computes which actions are OFFERED for a given unit from a PER-ACTION applicability DECLARATION (valid unit types + valid statuses), so an invalid action is hidden-or-disabled-with-reason — declared ONCE, never per-view if-statements. Covers Approve/Decline-only-at-QA, no-container-actions-on-Task, +Add-Diagram-only-on-diagrams-special-container.
